title: RedSalamanders scoped testing data (Tests/test-scopes.json, version 2)
description: The per-repository facts of the engine's scoped testing (Specs/ProjectCommands.md, Scoped testing). Everything else is engine behavior.

buildNumber.description: none: build.ps1 receives no build number. mergeBaseCount: -BuildNumber is the commit count of HEAD's merge base with the comparison base (of HEAD when that base does not resolve).

nativeInventory.description: Declared native test sources. Required when any scope is native.

exclude.description: Historical or external sources that never enter the inventory.

testFolders.description: Folders whose every .cpp and .h is a native test source.

runtimeFiles.description: Deployed non-binary files under .build/<platform>/<configuration> that native results depend on.

prose.description: Paths that select every non-native scope and no native one, unless a rule naming Markdown explicitly maps them.

unscoped.description: Paths that select no scope when no rule maps them.

projectBindings.description: Native projects whose compiled inputs and transitive local includes become exact-path rules.

overrides.description: Inputs matching a pattern take only these scopes from this project.

includeRoots.description: Folders that #include names may be relative to.

exclude.description: Paths never treated as local include targets.

interactiveObligations.description: Suites that need the person's interactive desktop. Scoped testing lists them as INTERACTIVE_NOT_RUN and never runs them.

watchedProcesses.description: Native test executables (image file names) that write .build/test-artifacts; evidence capture refuses while one runs from this checkout's .build.

profileFailureImages.description: Optional native test executable names whose linked images and PDBs accompany current FailureEvidence from a configured build profile.

prePushProfiles.description: Every profile the repository qualifies locally; PrePush runs them in this order in one call.

buildOnly.description: Builds the profile and runs no runtime test, for a platform the local host does not run.

instrumentationVariables.description: Environment variables that instrument test execution. While one is set, no receipt or iteration baseline is written or reused.

systemFiles.description: Files under %SystemRoot%/System32 whose bytes bind native evidence (graphics, text and imaging runtimes).

native.description: Native scopes are suites of test.ps1; the others run their commands.

reuse.description: Whether an identical earlier pass may be reused.

exclusive.description: One exact path whose match replaces every other rule and the prose rule.

additive.description: Adds its scopes to a path that another rule maps, but never maps a path by itself.
